note: Deterministic CI failure signature registry. Consumed by scripts/ci/classify-workflow-failure.mjs and the CI Recovery workflow (.github/workflows/ci-recovery.yml). Classification is derived ONLY from log signatures present in the failed run's logs — never from history, run count, or narrative. Matchers are lowercase substrings; the classifier lowercases the log before comparing. Categories are evaluated in `priority` order and the FIRST whose matchers hit wins. UNKNOWN has no matchers and is the terminal fallback. The ONLY category that may grant an automatic retry is SSH_TCP_TIMEOUT (transient=true, maxRetry=1); it is deliberately evaluated LAST among the real categories, so any more-specific, non-transient signature pre-empts a retry. A retry is allowed only when the matched category is transient AND maxRetry>=1 AND run_attempt===1.

SSH_AUTH.description: SSH authentication/handshake was rejected. The host was reachable but the key/username was not accepted. Not transient — a retry cannot fix a bad credential.
SSH_AUTH.ownerAction: SSH authentication failed — the box was reachable but rejected the credential. Verify/rotate the VPS_SSH_KEY / DEVELOP_SSH_KEY secret and the matching VPS_USER / DEVELOP_SSH_USER + authorized_keys on the box. No automatic retry (a retry cannot fix a credential).

DATABASE_INFRA.description: A database / service-container was unreachable or unhealthy (e.g. the outbox-db Postgres service container in CI). Not auto-retried here: recovery only re-runs SSH transport timeouts, and a DB-infra failure needs the runner/service inspected.
DATABASE_INFRA.ownerAction: Database / service-container was unreachable or unhealthy. Inspect the Postgres service container health (outbox-db job) or the target DB availability. No automatic retry — re-run manually once the DB is confirmed healthy.

DEPLOY_PROOF.description: The SSH transport SUCCEEDED and the remote script ran, but the post-deploy proof failed: /api/build-info reported the wrong commit SHA, or the live smoke (routes / canonical / single-FAQPage / crew) failed. A retry re-runs the same code and would fail the same way.
DEPLOY_PROOF.ownerAction: SSH succeeded but the deployed box did not verify (build-info SHA mismatch or live smoke failure). Inspect the box: did `pm2 restart --update-env` pick up APP_COMMIT_SHA, is .env.local intact, did `npm run build` actually complete? No automatic retry — the code/box state must be fixed first.

REMOTE_BUILD.description: The SSH transport SUCCEEDED and the remote command ran, but the build/install failed on the box (npm ci / next build / typecheck / lint). Not a transport issue — a retry re-runs the same failing build.
REMOTE_BUILD.ownerAction: Remote build/install failed on the box (npm ci / next build / typecheck). Fix the build and push a corrected commit — a re-run of the same commit would fail identically. No automatic retry.

SSH_TCP_TIMEOUT.description: The SSH client could not establish the TCP connection to the box before the remote command ran (e.g. `dial tcp ***:22: i/o timeout`). This is a transport-layer blip — the box may be momentarily unreachable or the runner had a network hiccup. Eligible for exactly ONE bounded automatic re-run, only on run_attempt 1.
SSH_TCP_TIMEOUT.ownerAction: Transient SSH transport timeout (could not reach the box before the remote command ran). The recovery workflow re-runs the failed jobs exactly once on run_attempt 1. If it recurs on attempt >= 2, the box is likely genuinely unreachable on :22 — verify the VPS is up, port 22 is open to GitHub runner egress, then re-run the deploy manually.

UNKNOWN.description: No known signature matched. Deliberately never auto-retried — an unrecognized failure must be inspected, not blindly re-run. If it becomes a recurring class, add a signature above.
UNKNOWN.ownerAction: No known failure signature matched this log. Inspect the full run manually. If this is a new, recurring failure class, add a matcher to scripts/ci/failure-signatures.json (with a fixture + expected verdict in scripts/ci/fixtures/ci-recovery/) so it classifies deterministically next time. No automatic retry.
